answer.justification: Only logit-level data is available. Top-1 agreement 0.938 and sequence agreement 0.562 fall in the fine-tuned ranges (0.900-0.938, 0.47-0.64) and are above the system-prompted ranges (0.861-0.908, 0.31-0.48). Token-DiFR gap 0.226 fits fine-tuned (0.10-0.31) and is too large for quantized (0.03-0.04). TV 0.076 is at the low edge of the fine-tuned range (0.076-0.099). The decisive feature is raw-score shift ÷ TV of 11.5, which is just above the fine-tuned maximum of 10.8. It is far outside quantized (2.2-2.3) and system-prompted (3.3-3.9), so the label is fine-tuned. KL 0.071 sits in the overlap of quantized and fine-tuned, and the quantized option is ruled out mainly by the DiFR gap and the high raw-score ratio. Base is excluded because every value is non-zero.
